case_title: AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING VS AMOR, HERZEL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT AMOR, HERZEL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-06-1993 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 02

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AMOR, HERZEL $1,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $50.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,550.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
